voice.instruct: male, middle-aged, low pitch, american accent

scenes.say: Add up the odd numbers, and something strange happens.
scenes.visual: 1 + 3 + 5 + 7 = ? is written on in the centre (Manim Write), the ? in yellow.

scenes.say: One. Plus three. Plus five. Plus seven.
scenes.caption: 1. Plus 3. Plus 5. Plus 7.
scenes.visual: Equation transforms down; each L-shaped layer of tiles grows in on its number, colour-matched to its term.

scenes.say: You always get a perfect square.
scenes.visual: Yellow outline is drawn around the 4x4 block on 'square'; the ? becomes 4 squared; side lengths labelled 4.

scenes.say: Each odd number is just the next L-shaped layer.
scenes.visual: Layers separate slightly on 'L-shaped' and light up one after another, then settle back.

scenes.say: So the first n odd numbers always add up to n squared.
scenes.caption: So the first n odd numbers always add up to n².
scenes.visual: General formula written below: 1 + 3 + ... + (2n - 1) = n squared, n in yellow.
